title: E0087: Command execution with backticks
plain_english: Passing user input to the backtick (shell execution) operator can allow an attacker to run arbitrary shell commands on the server.
why_matters: Command injection can lead to: - Reading sensitive files (such as `/etc/passwd`, source code, or credentials) - Modifying or deleting data - Installing malware or backdoors - Full server compromise
what_it_checks: `shell_exec()`, `exec()`, `system()`, and `passthru()` with tainted input (also covered by E0127-E0131)
